description: California Rail Stations is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The rail stations in California existing passenger rail system. All station information was compiled from Amtrak Operating Timetable 45 and commuter rail websites for Metrolink, ACE, Caltrain, and Coaster. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans, Clearing House, Rail, Stations. The bounding box given is -124.1593,32.7167,-114.6064,41.2125. The hub shows 2023-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This dataset is public.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
